name: Kashiwagi Airi
source:
"Teach me lots of things, onii-chan! ♪"

A bright and energetic female student.

She's childish for her age, possessing neither experience with men nor sexual knowledge. She is incredibly naiive around other people, though for some her innocent personality is appealing.

She falls prey to Tetsuo's flawed (?) sex education.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/chikandensya/chikan_top.htm]Official Site[/url]]
